title: Sean O'Sullivan (SOSV Managing GP) — 'more important to our society at this time than ever before'
summary: Sean O'Sullivan, SOSV's Managing GP, publicly endorses Incorruptible on LinkedIn after his fund's Deep Tech Live episode with Eric and Po Bronson, framing the book as beyond AI/LLM and highly actionable for the moment.
blockquote: I'm now halfway through the book Incorruptible, and while some of the stories are familiar -- the angle on it is new. And more important to our society at this time than ever before. Please look it up and buy it. It's great. This is not just for AI LLM companies. This is for all of us to educate ourselves on. Best yet, it's highly #Actionable.
